stock.description: Huazhong In-Vehicle Holdings Company Limited operates as an investment holding entity primarily dedicated to the production and global distribution of automobile body components, serving markets both within Mainland China and abroad. Its extensive product range encompasses structural, internal, and external decorative parts for vehicles, including crucial components like front and rear bumpers, dashboard assemblies, ABCD-pillars, air intake grilles, and rocker panels. The company also specializes in manufacturing precision molds and tooling for the automotive industry, as well as casings for air conditioning units and associated liquid tanks. Diversifying beyond automotive applications, it produces non-automobile items such as top cowl covers for marine engine applications and parts for office chairs. In addition to manufacturing, Huazhong In-Vehicle provides comprehensive services spanning the design, consultation, production, and sale of plastic and automotive parts. It actively participates in international trade, managing the import and export of a wide array of products and technologies. The company further engages in processing and distributing plastic, latex, and various spare and accessory parts, alongside developing advanced in-vehicle systems and equipment. Its clientele comprises original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), automotive body parts producers, and key suppliers within the automotive sector. Founded in 1993, the company underwent a name change in January 2015, transitioning from Huazhong Holdings Company Limited to its current designation. Headquartered in Xiangshan, China, Huazhong In-Vehicle Holdings Company Limited operates as a subsidiary under the umbrella of Huayou Holdings Company Limited.
